root_cause.text: In the cadence-quadspi driver's remove callback, the controller was disabled via register access before ensuring the device was runtime resumed, leading to an unclocked register access when the device is suspended.
root_cause.evidence: The patch moves the `cqspi_controller_enable(cqspi, 0)` call from before `pm_runtime_get_sync()` to after it, inside the `if (ret >= 0)` block, ensuring registers are accessed only after the device is awake and clocks are enabled.

agent_logs.evidence_points: The patch moves the `cqspi_controller_enable(cqspi, 0)` call from before `pm_runtime_get_sync()` to after it, inside the `if (ret >= 0)` block, ensuring registers are accessed only after the device is awake and clocks are enabled.

intent_record.intent_summary: Move controller disable into runtime PM success check to avoid disabling hardware when PM sync fails.
intent_record.what: Moved cqspi_controller_enable(cqspi, 0) inside the if (ret >= 0) block, adding braces, so it is now called only when pm_runtime_get_sync succeeds, alongside clk_bulk_disable_unprepare.
intent_record.how: The controller disable is now conditional on successful runtime PM get, preventing hardware operations when the PM sync fails.

grouping_result.intent: Move controller disable into runtime PM success check to avoid disabling hardware when PM sync fails.

relevance_review.reason: The group moves the controller disable operation into the runtime PM success check, which directly addresses the root cause by ensuring that register access only occurs after the device is runtime resumed, preventing unclocked register access.

candidates.rationale: This disables the controller via register access before ensuring the device is runtime resumed, leading to an unclocked register access when the device is suspended.

vuln_statements.explanation: This statement disables the controller via register access without first ensuring the device is runtime resumed. When the device is suspended, this leads to an unclocked register access, which is the root cause of the vulnerability.
